admission.justification: Receipt integrity, explicit host-list completeness, bounded projection retention and visible-lifetime polling are separate obligations; none alone makes immediate cached steering both truthful and resource bounded.

guarantee: Canonical tree receipts and one explicitly complete-or-incomplete live-agent census supply preclick chat knowledge with fresh single-document correction. Per-document corruption, unreached agents and exceeded receipt limits remain unknown, not empty; receipt acquisition is path-deduplicated and request-local, and periodic preloading exists only while pane and tab are shown. Together these keep immediate steering truthful without unbounded receipt retention or unseen background census work.
title: Bounded preclick knowledge never invents missing document chats
